The '''Republic military outpost''' was a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] base that was located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]]. During the [[Battle of Argul]], the base was attacked and overwhelmed by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
